text:
Maya: Dropping a micro one-pager draft for field + webinar. Goal: <350 words, single-sided PDF, sales-ready. Focus: Security choices + SLA tradeoffs across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Link: https://docs.google.com/internal/brief (internal)
Eli: Love the structure. Can we lead with a 30s "why it matters" hook that hooks CISOs and platform leads?
Suresh: Add a tiny benchmark panel: p95 chat latencies (short convo) + a headline cost delta vs Hosted for Dedicated/Private. One-line each.
Nia: For compliance copy: call out KMS integrations, SOC2, optional HSM support, and audit log retention. Keep it plain English.
Maya: Added a 3-row quick-tradeoff (Latency | Cost Predictability | Data Control) with one-phrase cells. Also added a 4-question "Ask the customer" checklist.
Eli: For webinar: 3-slide arc (problem, how Redwood solves it, live failover demo). Need a 2-bullet landing blurb and a 1-minute host script.
Suresh: Ops wants a compact failover snippet we can show in a slide. Something like: "if region healthy -> primary pool; else -> fallback pool with compatible model variant" plus canary config.
Maya: Pasted a simple YAML canary example: ```yaml
canary:
  rollout_percent: 10
  watch_window: 30m
  fallback_on_error: true
```
Nia: Wording tweak: use "near-identical SLA" for fallback to avoid absolute guarantees. Added an escalation path line: "Support -> 1hr P1 response; dedicated account escalation for enterprise"
Eli: Add a procurement-friendly bullet: one-line "expected unit cost delta vs Hosted (typical): Dedicated ~+40%, Private varies -> contact sales" so procurement has a kernel for RFPs.
Suresh: I'll flatten two workload samples into one-sentence callouts: e-commerce pilot (10k msgs/day) and finserv at scale (50k msgs/day) with p95s and rough $/1k-token deltas.
Maya: Also included a tiny inbound routing play: SalesOps can auto-tag leads with deploy_interest=hosted/dedicated/private and compliance_tag=ciso/regulated to trigger field routing. Mention a tag CSV export.
Eli: For the 30s host script: 1) Problem: unpredictable latency/cost + compliance constraints; 2) Redwood: unified API, routing, fallback; 3) CTA: book 20-min field demo and qualify for Dedicated trial. Keep under 60 words.
Nia: Compliance reviewers: keep HSM/KMS line but remove legal terms like "warranty". Added "customer-managed key options available" line.
Maya: Final checklist for the one-pager: 30s hook, 3-row tradeoff, 3 customer signals (pilot, predictable throughput need, regulated workloads), 1-line benchmarks, compliance bullets, CTA + qualification checkbox. Keep under 350 words.
Suresh: For the slide demo, I'll prepare a tiny traffic chart and a mock outage timeline to show failover in action.
Eli: I'll produce two landing blurb variants: long (for email) and short (for registration).
Maya: Timeline: need final PDF by Friday 09:00 for webinar promo batch. Who can lock copy by Thu EOD?
Eli: I can finalize host script + landing blurb by Thu noon.
Suresh: I'll finalize bench numbers + slide failover chart by Thu 4pm.
Nia: I'll do compliance sign-off by Thu 6pm and post any micro-edits here.
Maya: Thanks — will merge and drop PDF Thu night. ops-bot: Note: linked doc updated by Maya 7 minutes ago
Maya: Quick note for SalesOps: suggested lead tag CSV headers: email,company,deploy_interest,compliance_flag,estimated_monthly_tokens. Will hand off after final.
